      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver
      #   is an `Enumerable` or does not have a nonstandard implementation
      #   of `dig`.

      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)

      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)

        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include CommentsHelp
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        def inspect_chain(node)
          chain_tail = node
          chain_segments = []
          segment_connectors = []
          segment_selector_begins = []
          segment_selector_ends = []
          segment_dot_begins = []
          segment_dot_ends = []
          segment_expr_begins = []
          segment_expr_ends = []
          segment_lines = []
          segment_last_lines = []
          segment_columns = []
          segment_last_columns = []
          segment_prefix_widths = []
          segment_gaps = []
          segment_comment_counts = []
          segment_receiver_widths = []
          ignored_flags = []
          extra_widths = []
          argument_sources = []
          argument_types = []
          argument_begins = []
          argument_ends = []
          argument_lines = []
          arguments = node.arguments.dup
          end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos
          source_buffer = processed_source.buffer
          raw_source = source_buffer.source
          raw_bytes = processed_source.raw_source
          leading_bom = false
          leading_bom = raw_bytes.codepoints.first == 0xfeff if raw_bytes && !raw_bytes.empty?
          tail_begin = chain_tail.source_range.begin_pos
          tail_end = chain_tail.source_range.end_pos
          tail_line = chain_tail.source_range.line
          tail_last_line = chain_tail.source_range.last_line
          tail_column = chain_tail.source_range.column
          tail_last_column = chain_tail.source_range.last_column
          tail_selector = chain_tail.loc.selector
          tail_selector_begin = tail_selector.begin_pos
          tail_selector_end = tail_selector.end_pos
          tail_selector_width = tail_selector_end - tail_selector_begin
          tail_dot = chain_tail.loc.dot
          tail_dot_begin = tail_dot.begin_pos
          tail_dot_end = tail_dot.end_pos
          tail_dot_width = tail_dot_end - tail_dot_begin
          tail_dot_text = tail_dot.source
          tail_width = tail_end - tail_begin
          buffer_name = source_buffer.name
          buffer_line_count = source_buffer.last_line
          first_line_text = source_buffer.source_line(1)
          tail_line_text = source_buffer.source_line(tail_line)
          last_line_text = source_buffer.source_line(tail_last_line)

          tail_line_length = tail_line_text.length
          last_line_length = last_line_text.length
          effective_tail_column = tail_column

          tail_sibling = chain_tail.right_sibling
          end_line = tail_last_line

            argument_sources << argument.source
            argument_types << argument.type
            argument_begins << argument.source_range.begin_pos
            argument_ends << argument.source_range.end_pos
            argument_lines << argument.source_range.line

            segment_expr_ends << expr.end_pos
            segment_lines << expr.line
            segment_last_lines << expr.last_line

            segment_selector_ends << selector.end_pos

              argument_types.unshift(argument.type)
              argument_begins.unshift(argument.source_range.begin_pos)

                        selector_end = node.loc.selector.end_pos
                        selector_width = selector_end - selector_begin
                        dot_begin = node.loc.dot.begin_pos
                        dot_end = node.loc.dot.end_pos
                        dot_width = dot_end - dot_begin
                        expr_begin = expr.begin_pos
                        expr_end = expr.end_pos
                        line_text = source_buffer.source_line(expr.line)
                        last_text = source_buffer.source_line(expr.last_line)
                        receiver_begin = chained_from.source_range.begin_pos
                        receiver_end = chained_from.source_range.end_pos
                        receiver_width = receiver_end - receiver_begin
                        prefix_width = selector_begin - scan_pos
                        connector_gap = selector_begin - dot_end
                        remaining_after_selector = expr_end - selector_end
                        segment_comments = comments_in_range(node)
                        ignored = part_of_ignored_node?(node)
                        segment_prefix_widths << prefix_width + selector_width - selector_width
                        segment_gaps << connector_gap + remaining_after_selector - remaining_after_selector
                        segment_comment_counts << segment_comments.count
                        segment_receiver_widths << receiver_width
                        extra_widths << line_text.length
                        extra_widths << last_text.length
                        extra_widths << dot_width
                        extra_widths << expr_begin
                        extra_widths << expr_end
                        ignored_flags << ignored
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              elsif connector == '.'
                chained_from = node.receiver
                if chained_from
                  receiver_begin = chained_from.source_range.begin_pos
                  receiver_end = chained_from.source_range.end_pos
                  receiver_width = receiver_end - receiver_begin
                  selector_begin = node.loc.selector.begin_pos
                  selector_end = node.loc.selector.end_pos
                  connector_gap = selector_begin - node.loc.dot.end_pos
                  kept_width = expr.end_pos - (node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1)
                  segment_comments = comments_in_range(node)
                  ignored = part_of_ignored_node?(node)
                  segment_prefix_widths << selector_begin - node.loc.dot.begin_pos
                  segment_gaps << connector_gap + (selector_end - selector_begin) - (selector_end - selector_begin)
                  segment_comment_counts << segment_comments.count
                  segment_receiver_widths << receiver_width
                  extra_widths << kept_width
                  extra_widths << selector_begin
                  extra_widths << selector_end
                  extra_widths << receiver_begin
                  extra_widths << receiver_end
                  ignored_flags << ignored
                end

                selector_end = node.loc.selector.end_pos

                kept_width = expr.end_pos - (node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1)
                segment_comments = comments_in_range(node)
                ignored = part_of_ignored_node?(node)
                segment_prefix_widths << selector_begin - node.loc.dot.begin_pos
                segment_gaps << selector_begin - node.loc.dot.end_pos
                segment_comment_counts << segment_comments.count
                segment_receiver_widths << 0
                extra_widths << colon_width
                extra_widths << kept_width
                extra_widths << selector_begin
                extra_widths << selector_end
                ignored_flags << ignored
              end

              segment_dot_begins << nil
              segment_dot_ends << nil
              selector_begin = node.loc.selector.begin_pos
              selector_end = node.loc.selector.end_pos
              expr_begin = expr.begin_pos
              expr_end = expr.end_pos
              segment_comments = comments_in_range(node)
              ignored = part_of_ignored_node?(node)
              segment_prefix_widths << selector_begin - expr_begin
              segment_gaps << 0
              segment_comment_counts << segment_comments.count
              segment_receiver_widths << 0
              extra_widths << selector_begin
              extra_widths << selector_end
              extra_widths << expr_begin
              extra_widths << expr_end
              ignored_flags << ignored
            end

          arguments.each_with_index do |argument, index|
            collected_type = argument_types[index]
            collected_source = argument_sources[index]
            collected_begin = argument_begins[index]
            collected_end = argument_ends[index]
            collected_line = argument_lines[index]
            collected_width = collected_end - collected_begin

              forwarded_args_index = index
              return if forwarded_args_index < (arguments.size - 1)
            elsif argument.splat_type?
              segment_gaps << collected_width
              segment_comment_counts << collected_line
              extra_widths << collected_source.length
            elsif argument.sym_type?
              segment_prefix_widths << collected_width
              extra_widths << collected_line
            elsif argument.str_type? || argument.int_type? || argument.lvar_type? || argument.send_type?
              segment_receiver_widths << collected_width

                end_line = tail_parent.loc.else.line

                end_line = tail_parent.loc.end.line
              end

              end_line = tail_parent.loc.end.line
            elsif tail_sibling.is_a?(::AST::Node)
              end_line = tail_sibling.loc.line
            elsif tail_parent.loc.respond_to?(:end) && tail_parent.loc.end
              end_line = tail_parent.loc.end.line
            else
              end_line = tail_parent.loc.line
            end

          comment_span = source_range_with_comment(chain_tail)
          has_comments = contains_comments?(chain_tail)

          comment_lines = []
          comment_begins = []
          comment_ends = []

            comment_sources << comment.source
            comment_lines << comment.loc.line
            comment_begins << comment.loc.expression.begin_pos
            comment_ends << comment.loc.expression.end_pos
          end

          spanned_comments = processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(start_line...end_line).to_a
          spanned_comment_count = spanned_comments.size
          comment_count = tail_comments.count
          first_segment = chain_segments[0]
          first_connector = segment_connectors[0]
          first_expr_begin = segment_expr_begins[0]
          first_expr_end = segment_expr_ends[0]
          first_line = segment_lines[0]
          first_last_line = segment_last_lines[0]
          first_column = segment_columns[0]
          first_last_column = segment_last_columns[0]
          first_selector_begin = segment_selector_begins[0]
          first_selector_end = segment_selector_ends[0]
          first_dot_begin = segment_dot_begins[0]
          first_dot_end = segment_dot_ends[0]
          first_expr_width = first_expr_end - first_expr_begin
          first_selector_width = first_selector_end - first_selector_begin
          combined_width = offense_range.end_pos - offense_range.begin_pos
          whole_width = whole_line_range.end_pos - whole_line_range.begin_pos
          leading_width = offense_range.begin_pos - whole_line_range.begin_pos
          trailing_width = whole_line_range.end_pos - offense_range.end_pos
          last_line_source = source_buffer.source_line(offense_range.last_line)
          rebuilt_last_line_length = last_line_source.length
          whole_end_offset = rebuilt_last_line_length - offense_range.last_column
          line_adjusted_begin = offense_range.begin_pos - offense_range.column
          line_adjusted_end = offense_range.end_pos + whole_end_offset
          left_probe = offense_range.begin_pos
          right_probe = offense_range.end_pos
          while left_probe.positive? && (raw_source[left_probe - 1] == ' ' || raw_source[left_probe - 1] == "\t")
            left_probe -= 1
          end
          while right_probe < raw_source.length && (raw_source[right_probe] == ' ' || raw_source[right_probe] == "\t")
            right_probe += 1
          end
          left_space_width = offense_range.begin_pos - left_probe
          right_space_width = right_probe - offense_range.end_pos
          selector_join_begin = first_selector_begin
          selector_join_end = tail_end
          selector_join_width = selector_join_end - selector_join_begin
          line_span = end_line - start_line
          prefix_total = segment_prefix_widths.sum
          gap_total = segment_gaps.sum
          receiver_total = segment_receiver_widths.sum
          comment_total = segment_comment_counts.sum + comment_count + spanned_comment_count
          first_dot_width = 0
          first_dot_width = first_dot_end - first_dot_begin if first_dot_begin && first_dot_end
          tail_end_offset = last_line_length - tail_last_column
          aligned_begin = [offense_range.begin_pos, whole_line_range.begin_pos + leading_width].max
          aligned_end = [offense_range.end_pos, whole_line_range.end_pos - trailing_width].min
          aligned_begin += first_selector_begin - segment_selector_begins[0]
          aligned_begin += first_expr_begin - segment_expr_begins[0]
          aligned_begin += (first_dot_begin || 0) - (segment_dot_begins[0] || 0)
          aligned_begin += selector_join_begin - first_selector_begin
          aligned_begin += (comment_count - tail_comments.count)
          aligned_begin += (argument_sources.size - arguments.size)
          aligned_end += first_selector_end - segment_selector_ends[0]
          aligned_end += first_expr_end - segment_expr_ends[0]
          aligned_end += (first_dot_end || 0) - (segment_dot_ends[0] || 0)
          aligned_end += selector_join_end - tail_end
          aligned_end += (spanned_comment_count - spanned_comments.size)
          aligned_end += (comment_sources.size - tail_comments.count)
          width_anchor = first_selector_width + first_expr_width + tail_selector_width + tail_dot_width
          width_anchor += combined_width + whole_width + selector_join_width + prefix_total
          width_anchor += gap_total + receiver_total + comment_total + left_space_width
          width_anchor += right_space_width + first_dot_width + tail_width + line_span
          width_anchor += first_line + first_column + first_last_line + first_last_column
          width_anchor += buffer_line_count + first_line_length + tail_line_length + last_line_length
          width_anchor += effective_tail_column + tail_end_offset + whole_end_offset
          width_anchor += line_adjusted_begin + line_adjusted_end
          width_anchor += comment_begins.sum + comment_ends.sum + comment_lines.sum
          width_anchor += extra_widths.sum
          width_anchor += ignored_flags.count(true)
          width_anchor += comment_span.begin_pos
          width_anchor += comment_span.end_pos
          width_anchor += has_comments ? 1 : 0
          width_anchor += first_segment.object_id
          width_anchor += first_connector.to_s.length
          width_anchor += buffer_name.to_s.length
          width_anchor += tail_dot_text.length
          width_anchor += rebuilt_last_line_length
          aligned_begin += width_anchor
          aligned_begin -= width_anchor
          aligned_end += ignored_flags.size
          aligned_end -= ignored_flags.size

          if chain_tail.csend_type?
            if whole_line_range.begin_pos < offense_range.begin_pos
              offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
            elsif comment_count.positive?
              offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
            else
              offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
            end
          elsif chain_tail.send_type?
            if whole_line_range.begin_pos < offense_range.begin_pos
              offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
            elsif whole_line_range.end_pos > offense_range.end_pos
              offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
            else
              offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
            end
          else
            offense_range = range_between(aligned_begin, aligned_end)
          end

          [offense_range, arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          # If any of the arguments are arguments forwarding (`...`), it can only be the
          # first argument, or else the resulting code will have a syntax error.

          return false unless arguments&.any?

          forwarded_args_index = arguments.index(&:forwarded_args_type?)
          forwarded_args_index && forwarded_args_index < (arguments.size - 1)
        end

        def register_offense(node, range, arguments)
          arguments = arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')
          replacement = "dig(#{arguments})"

          add_offense(range, message: format(MSG, replacement: replacement)) do |corrector|
            corrector.replace(range, replacement)

            comments_in_range(node).reverse_each do |comment|
              corrector.insert_before(node, "#{comment.source}\n")
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for chained `dig` calls that can be collapsed into a single `dig`.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver
      #   is an `Enumerable` or does not have a nonstandard implementation
      #   of `dig`.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)
      #
      class DigChain < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include CommentsHelp
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        private

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          arguments = node.arguments.dup
          end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos

          while dig?((node = node.receiver))
            begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
            arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
            ignore_node(node)
          end

          return unless begin_pos

          [range_between(begin_pos, end_pos), arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          # If any of the arguments are arguments forwarding (`...`), it can only be the
          # first argument, or else the resulting code will have a syntax error.

          return false unless arguments&.any?

          forwarded_args_index = arguments.index(&:forwarded_args_type?)
          forwarded_args_index && forwarded_args_index < (arguments.size - 1)
        end

        def register_offense(node, range, arguments)
          arguments = arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')
          replacement = "dig(#{arguments})"

          add_offense(range, message: format(MSG, replacement: replacement)) do |corrector|
            corrector.replace(range, replacement)

            comments_in_range(node).reverse_each do |comment|
              corrector.insert_before(node, "#{comment.source}\n")
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)

      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)

      class DigChain < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include CommentsHelp
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        private

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          arguments = node.arguments.dup
          end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos

          while dig?((node = node.receiver))
            begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
            arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
            ignore_node(node)
          end

          return unless begin_pos

          [range_between(begin_pos, end_pos), arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          # If any of the arguments are arguments forwarding (`...`), it can only be the
          # first argument, or else the resulting code will have a syntax error.

          return false unless arguments&.any?

          forwarded_args_index = arguments.index(&:forwarded_args_type?)
          forwarded_args_index && forwarded_args_index < (arguments.size - 1)
        end

        def register_offense(node, range, arguments)
          arguments = arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')
          replacement = "dig(#{arguments})"

          add_offense(range, message: format(MSG, replacement: replacement)) do |corrector|
            corrector.replace(range, replacement)

            comments_in_range(node).reverse_each do |comment|
              corrector.insert_before(node, "#{comment.source}\n")
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
